text: dsh-snapcompact 是 DSH Web 客户端的上下文压缩插件，将较早的对话编码为 PNG 位图帧，并以检查点消息替换选定历史。它通过 CompactionEngine 服务和 /snapcompact 命令接入，支持手动归档、空闲自动压缩、上下文压力触发和超限恢复，可按模型选择帧形状并保留近期纯文本。适合希望减少长会话上下文占用、同时保留旧对话记录的用户。需要 DSH attachments、sessions、tokenMeter 和 commands 服务；原生渲染器路径 PI_NATIVES_PATH 可选。

dsh-snapcompact compresses DSH session history into PNG frames, replacing it with a checkpoint. It offers manual and automatic compaction by service and chat command, keeping recent turns as text. It helps manage long sessions and needs DSH attachment, session, token meter, and command services.
想把很长的 DSH 对话压缩一下，又希望之后还能回看早期内容。
能不能把旧会话编码成图片保存，并留一部分最近消息为文字？
让 DSH 在上下文快满时自动归档较早的对话。
DSH 因上下文超限报错时，有办法压缩历史后继续请求吗？
Can I archive older chat history as images while keeping recent turns readable as text?
How can DSH compact a conversation automatically when the context window is under pressure?
I need to free up context without throwing away the complete earlier conversation. What can help?
Is there a way to manually archive a session's older turns with a chosen image layout?
dsh-snapcompact 的功能「手动归档」：把选定的较早会话历史编码成 PNG 帧并用检查点替换。通过 /snapcompact 触发，可用 --frames、--shape 调整帧数与形状，也可用 --all 不保留最近纯文本。
dsh-snapcompact 的功能「空闲自动压缩」：在 agent 空闲、上下文用量超过阈值且达到最低 token 数时启动归档。可用 /snapcompact auto on、off 或 threshold 调整。
dsh-snapcompact 的功能「自动压力处理」：可在 agent 步骤前按上下文压力尝试压缩，也会在收到上下文窗口超限错误时尝试归档并请求重试。
dsh-snapcompact 的功能「按模型和文字选择帧形状」：归档时根据 provider、model 及文本中的宽字符选择对应的字体与网格，再渲染成 PNG 图像帧。
dsh-snapcompact 使用 DSH attachments 服务保存图像帧，并把自动压缩偏好写入用户目录下的 snapcompact-config.json；DSH_HOME 可更改该目录。

dsh-snapcompact README · dsh-snapcompact：Bitmap-frame context compression plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

Inspired by [`@oh-my-pi/snapcompact`](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/tree/main/packages/snapcompact).

dsh-snapcompact README · dsh-snapcompact：Instead of asking an LLM to summarize discarded conversation history in lossy prose, snapcompact serializes the exact conversation and renders the text into dense PNG frames of pixel-font glyphs that vision models read back directly. The entire process is local, fast, and deterministic — no auxiliary LLM API calls, no summarization latency, and zero token-cost overhead beyond the compact bitmap frames.

dsh-snapcompact README · Features：- **Local & Deterministic**: High-throughput rasterization using native pixel-font rendering (`@oh-my-pi/pi-natives`).
- **Provider-Aware Shapes**:
  - `anthropic` (`11on16-bw`): 8x13 font on 11px advance, black-and-white.
  - `google` (`8on22-bw`): 8x13 font on 22px pitch, tuned for Gemini vision budget.
  - `openai` (`8on22-bw`): 8x13 font on 22px pitch, sent with `detail: "original"`.
  - `cjk` (`silver16-bw`): Silver TrueType font on 16x16 grid for East Asian (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) text.
- **Structured Transcript Serialization**:
  - `¶user:` user message sections
  - `¶think:` assistant reasoning blocks
  - `¶ai:` assistant message sections
  - `¶call: name(args)//intent` tool calls with parameters
  - `<out>...</out>` formatted tool results with dimmed noise
  - Automatic `FILES` section tracking read and modified files (`(Read)`, `(Write)`, `(RW)`)
- **DSH Attachment Integration**:
  - Renders PNG frames and persists them through `ctx.attachments.saveImages`
  - Fully compatible with DSH session persistence and replay
- **Command & Service Support**:
  - `/snapcompact [--frames <N>] [--shape <name>] [--all]` command for on-demand manual

dsh-snapcompact README · 1. Clone into DSH Profile：Clone the repository into your active DSH profile's `packages/` directory (e.g. `desktop`):

```bash
dsh-snapcompact README · Windows PowerShell：git clone https://github.com/JessenReinhart/dsh-snapcompact.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\packages\dsh-snapcompact"

dsh-snapcompact README · macOS / Linux：git clone https://github.com/JessenReinhart/dsh-snapcompact.git ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/packages/dsh-snapcompact
```

dsh-snapcompact README · 3. Native Rasterizer：Snapcompact uses the high-performance native pixel-font rasterizer binary (`pi_natives.<platform>.node`).

The plugin automatically discovers this binary from any of:
- `~/.omp/natives/<version>/pi_natives.<platform>.node`
- `~/.bun/install/cache/@oh-my-pi/pi-natives-*`
- Environment variable override: `PI_NATIVES_PATH=/path/to/pi_natives.<platform>.node`

dsh-snapcompact README · 4. Restart DSH：Restart DeepSeek Harness to load the profile bundle. In chat, test with:
```
/snapcompact status
```

dsh-snapcompact README · Commands：- `/snapcompact` — Archive older history immediately using smart defaults (auto shape, max 8 frames, retains 16% recent tokens in plain text).
- `/snapcompact auto` — Toggle automatic background compaction when the agent is idle.
- `/snapcompact auto on` — Enable automatic idle compaction.
- `/snapcompact auto off` — Disable automatic idle compaction.
- `/snapcompact auto threshold <pct>` — Set context window threshold percentage to trigger idle compaction (default 80%).
- `/snapcompact status` — Display current configuration, threshold, and live session token usage.
- `/snapcompact --frames <N>` — Archive history with custom maximum frame count.
- `/snapcompact --shape <name>` — Archive history with specific font/shape variant (`11on16-bw`, `8on22-bw`, `silver16-bw`).
- `/snapcompact --all` — Archive all eligible history without retaining recent plain text.
dsh-snapcompact README · Persistence：Auto-compaction preferences are saved to `~/.dsh/snapcompact-config.json` and persist across sessions and application restarts.
